rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: In the Rajya Sabha on 15 July 1996, on the item headed 'Re. reported remarks made by Home Minister against President of Congress Party', the Leader of the House, Shri Inder Kumar Gujral, says that the Government has 'the highest esteem and respect for the President of the Congress Party, Shri Narasimha Rao'.
